fb_text:
My phone used to ring all day. Gate codes. Shut-offs. Every little question from the crew.

So I started voice-noting every stop. Every job detail goes into FieldNotes — and it remembers all of it.

Now my crew asks the bot instead of calling me. My phone stays in my pocket.

I run a commercial plant service in Atlanta — 50+ corporate and commercial properties in the Metro Atlanta area — and I built FieldNotes for my own business first. Then I made it for every owner who runs their company from a text thread.

Try it free for 30 days, no credit card: fieldnotesapp.io/app/try.html
